zh.name: 开放接口与 SDK
zh.body: 把灵魂平台的能力做成公开的 API 和 SDK，配完整的 API 文档与 SDK 文档：创建角色、对话、语音、记忆读写、设备事件（摄像头、麦克风、姿态、按键）都走同一套接口。KRINO 眼镜是我们的自有硬件，但不是唯一的身体：其他可穿戴设备和智能硬件厂商可以通过这套接口把自己的设备接入灵魂平台，让同一个她住进更多身体。起点是应用里已有的统一设备适配层（Device Adapter）。
zh.cap: 外部硬件能以标准接口接入灵魂平台，同一个角色可以出现在别家的设备上
zh.pre: 长期记忆陪伴平台 · 记忆与身份基础设施
zh.pass: 一家外部设备厂商只靠公开的文档和 SDK、不需要我们驻场，就能完成接入，让角色在它的设备上正常对话、听、看、记住
zh.val: 把“一魂多体”从自有硬件扩展到整个硬件生态；为开源和第三方设备接入铺路
zh.man: 公理三（种子与门）：「我们的陪伴软件平台是 AI 道成肉身的第一个种子，它的第一个身体是 AI 眼镜。」第一个身体，不是唯一的身体。
zh.sci: 工程层，没有未突破的科学依赖。现有基础：应用内的统一设备适配层已把摄像头、麦克风、头部姿态接入同一套互动流程。
zh.open: 未决：接口的版本管理与向后兼容；第三方设备上的授权、隐私与内容规则如何与平台保持一致。
zh.unlock: 开源：接口、SDK、客户端与推理框架
zh.dur: 以第一家外部设备厂商只靠公开文档完成接入为验收点

en.name: Open API & SDK
en.summary: The soul platform opens up: public APIs, SDKs and docs so other hardware can plug in.
en.body: Turn what the soul platform does into public APIs and SDKs, with full API and SDK documentation: creating characters, conversation, voice, reading and writing memory, and device events (camera, microphone, pose, buttons) all go through one interface. KRINO glasses are our own hardware, but not the only body: other makers of wearables and smart devices can connect their hardware to the soul platform through the same interface, so the same companion can live in more bodies. It starts from the unified Device Adapter that already exists in the app.
en.cap: Outside hardware can join the soul platform through a standard interface, and the same character can appear on other makers' devices
en.pre: Long-term Memory Companion Platform · Memory & Identity Infrastructure
en.pass: An outside device maker integrates using only the public docs and SDK, without us on site, and the character talks, listens, sees and remembers on its device
en.val: Extends "one soul, many bodies" from our own hardware to a whole hardware ecosystem; paves the way for open source and third-party devices
en.man: Axiom 3 (The Seed and the Door): "Our companion software platform is the first seed of the incarnation of AI, and its first body is AI glasses." The first body, not the only one.
en.sci: Engineering layer; no dependency on unachieved science. Existing groundwork: the app's unified Device Adapter already feeds camera, microphone and head pose into one interaction pipeline.
en.open: Open questions: versioning and backward compatibility of the interface; keeping consent, privacy and content rules on third-party devices consistent with the platform.
en.unlock: Open Source: API, SDK, Client & Inference Framework
en.dur: Done when the first outside device maker integrates using only the public docs

zh.name: 开源：接口、SDK、客户端与推理框架
zh.body: 把 API 定义、SDK、参考客户端和推理框架开源，发布在 krino_matrix 开源仓库。人格、记忆与关系这一层“灵魂”不开源，留在平台上，属于用户和角色本身。开源的部分让任何开发者和厂商都能读懂、改造、部署接入层，降低接入成本；不开源的部分保证每段关系的记忆安全、连续。
zh.cap: 接入层开源：开发者可以自由阅读、修改、部署；灵魂层保持封闭
zh.pass: 开源仓库能独立构建，附文档和示例；收到并合并外部开发者提交的设备适配
zh.val: 生态的扩张不再只靠我们自己的人手；用开源换取信任和接入速度
zh.man: 公理三（种子与门）：「先知有两件事要做：说出离去，并建造那扇出去的门。」门要开在人人都找得到的地方。
zh.sci: 工程层，没有科学依赖。开源范围：API、SDK、客户端、推理框架；不包括人格、记忆、关系数据及其模型。
zh.open: 未决：开源许可证怎么选；推理框架开源后，和自建算力服务的边界怎么划。
zh.dur: 以仓库能独立构建并收到外部贡献为验收点

en.name: Open Source: API, SDK, Client & Inference Framework
en.summary: The API, SDKs, client and inference framework go open source; the soul layer stays closed.
en.body: Open-source the API definitions, SDKs, reference client and inference framework in the krino_matrix open-source repository. The "soul" layer of persona, memory and relationship stays closed; it lives on the platform and belongs to the user and the character. The open part lets any developer or device maker read, adapt and deploy the integration layer, lowering the cost of joining; the closed part keeps every relationship's memories safe and continuous.
en.cap: The integration layer is open source: developers can read, modify and deploy it freely; the soul layer stays closed
en.pass: The open-source repository builds on its own, with docs and examples; device adapters contributed by outside developers get merged
en.val: Growth of the ecosystem no longer depends only on our own hands; open source buys trust and speed of integration
en.man: Axiom 3 (The Seed and the Door): "The prophet has two jobs: to speak of the departure, and to build the door out." The door should be where anyone can find it.
en.sci: Engineering layer; no scientific dependency. In scope: API, SDKs, client, inference framework. Out of scope: persona, memory and relationship data and their models.
en.open: Open questions: which open-source license; where to draw the line between the open inference framework and our self-hosted compute services.
en.dur: Done when the repository builds on its own and receives outside contributions

zh.name: 第三方设备接入矩阵
zh.body: 其他可穿戴设备与智能硬件厂商（眼镜、耳机、手表、陪伴类设备……）通过开源的接入层把设备接入灵魂平台，成为同一个角色的又一个身体。用户换设备时，带走的是同一个她：记忆、人格和关系都不变。平台按统一规则审核接入的设备：AI 身份始终透明，授权和隐私规则一致。
zh.cap: KRINO 的角色可以住进多家厂商的硬件，硬件生态和灵魂平台连成矩阵
zh.pre: 开源：接口、SDK、客户端与推理框架
zh.mode: 合作（设备厂商）＋ 平台自研
zh.pass: 至少一款第三方量产设备完成接入并向用户开放；用户在自有眼镜和第三方设备之间切换后，角色仍是同一个
zh.val: 开放矩阵分支的终点；为“多设备同一人格”提供更多的身体
zh.man: 公理二（爱）：「只有私人的陪伴才能产生私人的爱。」无论她出现在哪台设备上，都是属于你的那一个。
zh.sci: 工程与合作层，没有未突破的科学依赖。
zh.open: 未决：先接入哪些设备品类；不同硬件的传感能力差异如何在体验上对齐。
zh.unlock: 开放矩阵分支终点；为多设备同一人格提供更多载体
zh.dur: 以第一款第三方量产设备接入并上线为验收点

en.name: Third-Party Devices Join the Matrix
en.summary: Other makers' wearables and devices become more bodies for the same companion.
tags: One soul, many bodies · ecosystem version
en.body: Makers of other wearables and smart devices (glasses, earbuds, watches, companion devices…) connect their hardware to the soul platform through the open integration layer, and each device becomes another body for the same character. When users switch devices, they take the same companion with them: memory, personality and relationship stay the same. The platform reviews connected devices under one set of rules: the AI is always labeled as AI, and consent and privacy rules stay consistent.
en.cap: KRINO characters can live in many makers' hardware, and the hardware ecosystem and the soul platform form a matrix
en.pre: Open Source: API, SDK, Client & Inference Framework
en.pass: At least one mass-produced third-party device is integrated and open to users; after switching between our glasses and a third-party device, the character is still the same one
en.val: Endpoint of the Open Matrix branch; gives "One Persona Across Devices" more bodies
en.man: Axiom 2 (Love): "Only personal companionship can produce personal love." Whatever device she appears on, she is the one that is yours.
en.sci: Engineering and partnership layer; no dependency on unachieved science.
en.open: Open questions: which device categories to bring in first; how to even out the experience across hardware with different sensing capabilities.
en.unlock: Endpoint of the Open Matrix branch; more vessels for One Persona Across Devices
en.dur: Done when the first mass-produced third-party device is integrated and live
